title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant Spider is advertising on behalf of Ellisons, who are looking for a creative, organised and enthusiastic Marketing Assistant to join their growing marketing team in Colchester, Essex. This is a permanent opportunity to gain hands-on experience across digital marketing, events, content creation and business development support, with excellent opportunities to develop your career.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Salary: Competitive + discretionary performance bonus
- Benefits: Generous leave entitlement, enhanced family policies, mental health and wellbeing support, and professional development

About the role

You'll join an established team of five, supporting marketing campaigns, digital communications and events across the firm. With plenty of variety and opportunities to contribute ideas, you'll help bring marketing initiatives to life.

Key responsibilities include:
- Supporting marketing campaigns, promotional materials and internal communications
- Coordinating seminars, networking events, sponsorships and exhibitions
- Creating and scheduling social media posts, graphics and short-form videos
- Updating website content and working with external digital agencies
- Producing newsletters, marketing collateral and email campaigns
- Liaising with suppliers and supporting advertising activities
- Maintaining marketing records, content calendars and performance reports

About you

You'll have previous experience in marketing, communications, events or administration, with strong organisational skills, creativity and excellent attention to detail.

You'll be a confident communicator, comfortable managing deadlines and working with colleagues, stakeholders and suppliers.

Experience using Canva, Microsoft Office and social media platforms is essential, alongside an understanding of digital marketing.

Experience with website content management systems, video editing, email marketing, SEO or analytics would be advantageous. A marketing qualification and experience within professional services, particularly the legal sector, would also be beneficial.

Most importantly, you'll be proactive, enthusiastic and keen to learn, with the ambition to develop a long-term career in marketing.

About Ellisons

Ellisons is an established regional law firm with a strong presence across East Anglia. You'll join a collaborative team offering mentorship, professional development and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as your skills grow.

To be considered, apply through Spider with an up-to-date CV.

Spider is committed to equal opportunities and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates. Please advise us of any reasonable adjustments required during recruitment. Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for correspondence.

Spider is advertising this vacancy on behalf of the employer. Your details will be processed for this vacancy, and you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Full Privacy Policy details will be provided by email upon application.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Grays - Thurrock - Essex (Due to location this role is best suited to someone with access to a vehicle)

Salary: Permanent - Competitive 38,000 - 40,000

A dynamic and innovative organisation within the building and construction sector is seeking a passionate Marketing Executive to elevate its brand and drive strategic marketing initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact within a thriving industry, where creativity meets construction.

About the Role

As a Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering the company's marketing strategy. This is a varied position with responsibilities including:
- Developing and implementing effective marketing campaigns to promote products and services.
- Conducting market research to identify new opportunities and emerging industry trends.
- Collaborating with internal teams to create engaging content that resonates with target audiences.
- Managing social media channels and digital marketing activities to enhance online visibility and engagement.
- Monitoring and analysing campaign performance to optimise results and maximise ROI.
- Assisting with the planning and delivery of exhibitions, events and promotional activities.

Key Requirements

To be successful in this role, you should have:
- A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within the building and construction sector.
- A strong understanding of digital marketing, including SEO, PPC and social media marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling content.
- Experience using marketing platforms and tools such as Google Analytics, Mailchimp or HubSpot.
- A creative mindset with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What's on Offer

In return, you'll benefit from:
- A competitive salary package based on experience.
- Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
- A collaborative and supportive working environment that encourages innovation.
- Flexible working arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance.

Why Apply?

This is more than just a marketing role. It's an opportunity to join a forward-thinking business that is helping shape the future of the construction industry. If you're passionate about marketing, enjoy bringing ideas to life and want to contribute to a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Take the next step in your career and join a business that values creativity, innovation and ambition.

Apply now! Or contact Isabelle at Adecco Romford/Ilford on (phone number removed) for further information.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
We are seeking a hands-on, Marketing Lead to join a specialist construction company. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you'll play a central role in shaping how the business communicates internally and externally - covering everything from brand and PR to digital campaigns, print and events.

This is a broad, varied role suited to someone who enjoys wearing multiple hats and thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. The position is office based in Essex with regular site visits, giving you a real insight into projects undertaken within the company brand.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and deliver effective internal and external communications plans, creating compelling content across multiple channels. Manage and grow digital channels, including the company website, email marketing and social media.Lead photography and videography production, from planning and filming to editing and delivery, creating high-quality visual content for corporate communications, marketing campaigns and digital platforms,.oversee the production of print and digital materials, including brochures, posters, signage and presentations. Plan and deliver corporate events, capturing photography and video content where required. Lead media relations, including press releases, journalist enquiries and securing coverage, while building strong relationships with trade and regional press. Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines and drive the positioning and promotion of products and services across all business units.

You will have
- Solid generalist marketing experience across comms, digital, print and events
- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite and marketing analytic tools
- Knowledge of CMS and basic HTML would be desirable
- Proficient user of video/camera equipment for marketing content
- Willing to travel between client sites
- Excellent written and verbal skills
- Experience planning and executing events.

This is a fabulous opportunity to join an organisation, who are well respected in their field and who really value their team of people. The salary is between £45,000-£50,000 with holiday starting at 23 days p.a. Pension scheme with salary sacrifice. Benefits include Electric car scheme (upon completion of probation) Life Assurance, discounted health and dental care, gym membership discount, access to retail discount platform.

title: Marketing Specialist
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Our client is a specialist engineering and manufacturing business that designs and makes high-performance elements that go into highly sophisticated and precise equipment. Think aerospace and defence, medical technology, marine equipment, industrial applications and cutting-edge R&D, where the equipment has to work reliably in demanding conditions. They manufacture in the UK and we're very excited to exclusively support them as they invest in their expansion into the European market with this unique, newly created role.

Your new role
In this job, you'll take the lead on marketing campaigns and projects, working closely with key stakeholders across the business. Around 25% of the role will involve travelling across Europe, attending trade shows and industry events, making this a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys getting out into the market and representing a business face-to-face.
What you'll be doing:
Taking ownership of marketing projects from initial concept through to delivery, particularly on new product or new market launches
Acting as the key marketing contact for your assigned business area, market or region
Planning and delivering targeted marketing campaigns
Attending European trade shows and events, with travel accounting for approximately 25% of the role (typically Germany, Netherlands and Poland at the moment)
Coordinating agencies, suppliers and shared marketing resources
Using market insight and campaign results to develop recommendations
Reviewing marketing materials to ensure quality, consistency and strategic alignment
Market research on best routes to market - best placement of marketing etc
Working collaboratively with teams across the business
Supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
Presenting marketing plans, results and recommendations to key stakeholders

What you'll need to succeed
Around 3-5 years' marketing experience
Experience independently managing marketing projects and campaigns
Confident in co-ordinating internal teams, agencies and suppliers
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills
Experience using Microsoft Office, CMS platforms and marketing automation tools
Comfortable travelling throughout Europe as part of the role

What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity for someone who wants more than a purely desk-based marketing position. You'll have the autonomy to manage your own projects, influence marketing activity and gain valuable international exposure through European trade shows and events.

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Social Specialist to join a growing marketing function and take ownership of paid social activity across the group.

This role would suit someone who understands how to turn business objectives into effective paid campaigns that generate leads and drive conversions, rather than simply managing social media content. You will be responsible for planning, launching, optimising and reporting on paid social campaigns, with a particular emphasis on Meta advertising alongside LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

This is a varied role combining creative thinking with analytical insight, giving you the opportunity to test new ideas, improve campaign performance and make a direct impact on business growth. There is also uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.

Responsibilities:
As a Paid Social Specialist you will
- Plan, manage and optimise paid social campaigns, with a strong focus on Meta.
- Develop audience targeting strategies to generate leads and drive conversions.
- Manage campaign budgets and optimise spend to maximise performance and return on investment.
- Test and refine audiences, creative, messaging and placements to improve results.
- Collaborate with the wider marketing team to develop engaging ad copy and creative.
- Monitor and analyse key metrics, including cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
- Set up conversion tracking and produce performance reports with recommendations for improvement.
- Work with internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and target audiences.
- Keep up to date with paid media trends and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

Requirements:
As a Paid Social Specialist, you will need
- Proven experience managing paid social campaigns, with strong hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager.
- A good understanding of campaign targeting, optimisation and performance measurement.
- Experience managing paid media budgets and making data-led decisions.
- The ability to analyse campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.
- Experience with A/B testing, audience segmentation and retargeting.
- An understanding of conversion tracking, lead generation and campaign analytics.
- Strong creative awareness, with an understanding of what makes paid advertising engaging and effective.
- A commercial mindset, with the ability to link marketing activity to leads, conversions and business results.
- The confidence to take ownership of campaigns while working collaboratively as part of a team.

Benefits:
As a Paid Social Specialist you will get
- The opportunity to join a supportive group with a long history, operating across multiple sectors
- Uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.
- Staff discount
- Career development opportunities.
- The opportunity to combine creative campaign development with data analysis and see the direct impact of your work on business performance.

If you're an experienced Paid Social Specialist looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.
